verdict.rationale: Buzz documents built-in voice huddles: users and agents can "drop into voice huddles", and the relay itself "hosts git + huddle audio", so audio calls happen inside the app rather than through an external service. Video calling is not evidenced; the video item covers playback with frame-anchored comments, which is a different feature. Missing for 10: evidence of video calls, explicit docs on starting a call from a channel versus a DM, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can start an audio or video call directly from a channel or DM without leaving the app

citations.quote: buzz-relay # WebSocket relay server — main entry point; also hosts git + huddle audio
